The cases are for React 17, which has no `useId`. `useVaseUiId` gives an id in `setup`.

exceptions.title: uses the id from a custom trigger render element for popup labelling
exceptions.reason: The case gives a React element with an `id` as `render`. In Vue `#render` is a slot, which is a function, so the part does not see the `id` of the element of the slot. The `id` prop gives the same result.

exceptions.title: uses an explicit label from the popup render element
exceptions.reason: The case gives a React element with an `aria-label` as `render`. In Vue `#render` is a slot, which is a function, so the part does not see the `aria-label` of the element of the slot. The `aria-label` attribute of the part gives the same result.

exceptions.title: keeps a list label supplied through a render element
exceptions.reason: The case gives a React element with an attribute of the list as `render`. In Vue `#render` is a slot, which is a function, so the part does not see an attribute of the element of the slot. The attribute of the part gives the same result.

exceptions.title: omits aria-controls when the list renders with an explicitly empty id
exceptions.reason: The case gives a React element with an `id` as `render`. In Vue `#render` is a slot, which is a function, so the part does not see the `id` of the element of the slot. The `id` prop gives the same result.

exceptions.title: points aria-controls at the id of a server-created render element
exceptions.reason: The case gives the lazy wrapper of the React Flight client as `render`.

exceptions.title: keeps selection state for an auto-focused input in Strict Mode
exceptions.reason: The case checks the selection state after the double effects of Strict Mode. Vue has no Strict Mode.

exceptions.title: warns that nested menus ignore the modal prop
exceptions.reason: The case gives `modal` to `Menu.SubmenuRoot` through a cast. That part has no such prop in Vase UI, and Vue warns about the attribute. The case 'warns that a menu in a menubar ignores modal={false}' covers the warning of Vase UI.

exceptions.title: does not emit the nested modal warning in production
exceptions.reason: The case runs only in jsdom, and it sets `process.env.NODE_ENV` to `production`. Vitest sets that value when it transforms a file for a browser, so only the Node project can change it. The case 'gives no warning for modal in a production build' of the Node file covers it.

exceptions.title: releases the subscriptions a submenu adds to its parent store when it unmounts
exceptions.reason: A submenu of Vase UI adds no subscription to the store of its parent. A selector of its store reads the reactive state of the parent.

exceptions.title: releases them under StrictMode
exceptions.reason: Vue has no Strict Mode. A submenu of Vase UI adds no subscription to the store of its parent.

exceptions.title: warns without an owner stack when React cannot provide one
exceptions.reason: `captureOwnerStack` is a React API. The warning of Vase UI has no owner stack.

exceptions.title: does not inspect rendered disabled elements in production
exceptions.reason: The case needs a production build. Vitest sets `process.env.NODE_ENV` when it transforms a file for a browser, so only the Node project can change it. A server render calls no `onMounted` hook, so the Node case asserts only that a server render in a production build gives no warning.
